method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.

scope: SCOPED to the traveller and small importer, one module. s 93 (declaring at the border and the Green Channel presumption), ss 128E, 128I and 128J (baggage, possession and duty-free allowance offences), s 128L(2) to (4), (6) and (7) (the penalty scale, deemed knowledge, specified offences), ss 115 and 115A (burden of proof, possession presumptions), ss 124 and 127 (unclaimed seizures, costs), ss 19 and 20 (refunds and short levies), s 136 (fuel when leaving by car). Not encoded: Parts 2 to 11 otherwise, most of Part 12, Part 13 (search and arrest), the rest of Parts 14 and 15, and the regulations. No duty rates, allowances or the fuel order were retrieved; the prescribed fuel minimum is a parameter.
